sketch:
Observe: SVG schematic with a battery, ammeter, and a "material slot"
between two electrodes. Dropdown selects a material sample: copper,
aluminum, tap water, salt water, distilled water, plastic, graphite.
Slider adjusts sample cross-section S and length ℓ. HUD: I (A),
computed resistivity ρ (Ω·m) via R = ρ·ℓ/S. A qualitative labeled
bar (conductor / semi-conductor / insulator) lights up per material.
Experiment: pick material + geometry to reach a target I. Evaluate:
current readout hidden; student predicts whether the circuit will
pass a "test lamp" threshold before revealing. Wrinkle: ρ values
pre-tabulated per material.
